payload.claim: `_keeping_graded_heads`'s docstring cites `(`SA-0304`, `DESIGN.md` §5.7)` as the origin of the graded-heads mechanism it implements, but ADR 7's own dated amendment (`docs/adr/0007-a-stack-batch-runs-the-spec-dag-and-writes-its-own-follow-ups.md:144-148`) attributes this exact mechanism, a finish built on the end review's graded head with a moved-after-grading escalation, to `SA-0306`, which is this spec itself. `SA-0304` elsewhere in the surrounding context only names the pre-existing split of `end_review` and `finish` calls inside `run_stack_batch` (`saffron/batch.py:898-958`), a different and unrelated fact. The citation misattributes the function's own origin to the wrong spec.
